en.t: This was precisely the tenth day of the third month.

units.source_text: 樱花盛开，天朗气清，真乃良辰美景。

en.t: The cherry blossoms were in full bloom, the sky was bright, and the air was clear; it was truly a beautiful day in a beautiful setting.

units.source_text: 佛菩萨所居极乐净土，景象恐与此地相仿。

en.t: The Pure Land of Ultimate Bliss where buddhas and bodhisattvas dwell was probably much like this place in appearance.

units.source_text: 即使并无特别深厚信仰的人，到此亦觉罪障消除。

en.t: Even people without any especially deep faith would feel, on coming here, that the burden of their sins had been cleansed away.

units.source_text: 僧众齐声朗诵《法华赞叹》的《樵薪》之歌，响落梁尘。

en.t: The monks chanted in unison the song Firewood from Praises of the Lotus Sutra, and their voices rang out as if they could shake the dust from the rafters.

units.source_text: 即使在平居静处之时，听了也会感动，何况此时，

en.t: Even in ordinary times, while sitting quietly at home, one would have been moved to hear it, and all the more so at this moment,

units.source_text: 紫夫人听了更觉凄凉寂寞，万念俱灰，

en.t: Lady Murasaki, hearing it, felt still more desolate and lonely, as though every thought had turned to ash,

units.source_text: 便即席吟诗，叫三皇子送给明石夫人，诗云：

en.t: and she composed a poem on the spot, asking the Third Prince to send it to Lady Akashi. The poem read:
